name: Claude Code
description: Installs Claude Code CLI using native binary installation

version.description: Select the version to install. Use 'stable' for the stable release, 'latest' for the most recent version, or specify a version number (e.g., '2.0.25').

useOAuthToken.description: If true, marks hasCompletedOnboarding as true to use OAuth token authentication.

autoUpdates.description: Enable automatic updates for Claude Code.

useSandbox.description: Install bubblewrap for sandbox support. Required for bash command sandboxing on Linux.

defaultPermissionMode.description: Default permission mode for devcontainer. Use 'bypassPermissions' for seamless operation (devcontainer safe), 'acceptEdits' for auto-approve edits, or 'askEachEdit' for manual review.

enableTeamMode.description: Enable experimental agent teams feature for collaborative multi-agent workflows.

model.description: Default Claude model to use (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929', 'claude-opus-4-6'). Leave empty to use Claude Code defaults.

apiBaseUrl.description: Custom API base URL via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL env var (e.g., 'http://localhost:8082'). Leave empty to use default Anthropic API.

customEnv.description: Custom environment variables in JSON format (e.g., '{"KEY":"value"}'). These will be merged into the env section of settings.json.
